definition: אֲסֵפָה noun feminine verbal. a collecting, gathering ; אַסִּיר ׳ אֻסְּפוּ א Isa 24:22 they are collected, as a collecting captives unto a pit (dungeon); or they are gathered with a gathering (as) captives , compare Isa 22:18 but perhaps read אֹסֶף הָאַסִּיר (construct); see Weir Che .
